ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The Science and Ethics of Sustainability. The focus of this interdisciplinary course will be on understanding some central aspects of our contemporary global environmental situation and on evaluating various perspectives on how people should respond to these realities. This section for Chancellor's Scholars only; others may only enroll with consent of Instructor and the Campus Honors Program. Class meets with (and available to other students) with CAS 587, GEOL 497, and RLST 494.
